paragraphs.en: After Billina’s successful mission, Dorothy and Evring sat quietly in the palace. The Nome King, content with his throne and pipe, was momentarily at peace until the bell above began to ring. Each chime grew more urgent; first "Rocketty-ricketts," then "Smudge and blazes," and finally "Hippikaloric."
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜顺利完成任务后，多萝西和埃文宁安静地坐在宫殿里。 Nome王正享受着他的王位和烟斗，暂时平静下来，直到上方的铃声开始响起。每一响都越来越急切：先是“火箭斯基特”，接着是“斯姆奇和熊熊烈火”，最后是“希皮卡洛里克”。

paragraphs.en: Enraged, the King hopped madly around the room, resembling a jumping-jack.
paragraphs.zh: 国王气得在房间里跳来跳去，就像一个弹力人偶。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy’s joy at each bell rang increased as she realized Billina had transformed more ornaments into living beings. She was amazed by Billina's success, knowing it required guessing from countless palace items. With ten transformations confirmed and the bell still ringing, Dorothy understood that not only Evring’s family but Ozma and her followers were also being restored.
paragraphs.zh: 随着比林娜将更多的装饰品转化为活生生的生物，丁多丽听到每声铃响都愈发欢喜。她对比林娜的成功感到惊讶不已，知道这需要从无数宫中器物中猜出正确的答案。十次转化已经确认成功，而铃声依旧未停，丁多丽意识到不仅埃文宁一家，奥兹玛及其随从也都正在恢复原状。

paragraphs.en: The King’s fury intensified, his roars nearly driving Dorothy to laughter. He summoned his warriors with a shrill whistle, and they marched into the throne room from gold and silver doors. Led by their stern captain, they formed ranks in an underground cavern below, awaiting orders.
paragraphs.zh: 国王的怒火愈发炽烈，吼声几乎让多萝西笑出声来。他尖啸着召集士兵，他们从金碧辉煌的大门中鱼贯而入，直抵宝座室。在严厉的队长带领下，士兵们列队站在地下的洞穴中，静候命令。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy moved to one side of the cavern as the warriors entered, holding Evring’s hand while the Lion and Tiger crouched nearby.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西退到洞穴的一侧，当战士们进入时握住厄林的手，而狮子和老虎则在附近蹲伏。

paragraphs.en: The king ordered his captain to seize Dorothy, but the Lion and Tiger snarled fiercely, deterring the warriors. The Nome King reassured them that the beasts couldn't move beyond their current positions.
paragraphs.zh: 国王命令他的队长逮捕多萝西，但狮子和老虎怒吼着，震慑住了战士们。 Nome王向他们保证，那些野兽无法超出它们当前的位置移动。

paragraphs.en: "Be careful!" warned the captain. "They can still bite anyone who tries."
paragraphs.zh: “小心！”船长警告道，“他们仍然会咬任何试图靠近的人。”

paragraphs.en: The king enchanted the animals again, ensuring they wouldn’t open their jaws. However, just then, the Sawhorse kicked the king with both hind legs, sending him flying into several warriors and bruising him badly.
paragraphs.zh: 国王再次施魔法让动物们闭上了嘴巴，然而就在这时，锯马用后腿给了国王一踢，将他踢飞撞进了几名战士身上，国王受了重伤。

paragraphs.en: “Ow! Murder! Treason!”
paragraphs.zh: “哎呀！谋杀！叛变！”

paragraphs.en: screamed the king. “Who did that?”
paragraphs.zh: 国王惊叫道：“是谁干的？”

paragraphs.en: “I did,” growled the Sawhorse. “You leave Dorothy alone or I’ll kick you again.”
paragraphs.zh: “我做到了，”锯马低吼道，“你别再惹多萝西，否则我会再次踢你。”

paragraphs.en: The king waved his hand at the Sawhorse, muttering a magical word. But despite the enchantment, the Sawhorse moved swiftly and kicked the king, sending him flying into his captain’s head.
paragraphs.zh: 国王对着飞马挥了挥手，嘴里念叨着一个魔法词。尽管施了魔法，飞马还是迅速移动，一踢之下将国王踢飞，直撞向他的船长的脑袋。

paragraphs.en: “Why didn’t my magic work?” wondered the king as he sat up, surprised.
paragraphs.zh: 国王惊讶地坐起身来，自言自语道：“为什么我的魔法没有起作用？”

paragraphs.en: “The creature is made of wood,” explained the captain. “Your magic won't affect it.”
paragraphs.zh: “这个怪物是由木头制成的，”船长解释道，“你的魔法对它无效。”

paragraphs.en: The king limped back to his throne, conceding that Dorothy could stay safe for now. The warriors reformed their ranks, and the Sawhorse stood beside the Hungry Tiger near Dorothy.
paragraphs.zh: 国王一瘸一拐地回到王座，承认道多丽特至少目前可以安全无虞。战士们重新整队，而锯马则站在饥饿的老虎身旁，靠近多丽特身边。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, doors opened, revealing people from both Ev and Oz. They paused in astonishment at the sight of the warriors and the angry Nome King.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，门开了，露出了来自艾夫和奥兹两地的人们。他们见到战士们和愤怒的诺姆王后国王停下了脚步，惊讶不已。

paragraphs.en: “Surrender!” shouted the king. “You are my prisoners.”
paragraphs.zh: “投降！”国王喊道，“你们都是我的俘虏。”

paragraphs.en: “Go on your way!” replied Billina. “You promised us safe passage if we guessed correctly.
paragraphs.zh: “你们走吧！”比琳娜说道，“如果我们猜对了，你承诺给我们安全通行的权利。”

paragraphs.en: You always keep your promises.”
paragraphs.zh: 你总是信守承诺。”

paragraphs.en: The king retorted, “I said you could leave the palace safely, not this room.”
paragraphs.zh: 国王反驳道：“我说你可以安全地离开宫殿，但不是这个房间。”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow replied sorrowfully, "One small blaze is enough to reduce me to ashes."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人悲伤地回答：“一场小小的火灾就足以将我化为灰烬。”

paragraphs.en: "Do you surrender?" demanded the King.
paragraphs.zh: “你投降吗？”国王厉声问道。

paragraphs.en: Billina whispered something in the Scarecrow's ear, making him smile. He put his hands in his jacket pockets.
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜在稻草人耳边低语了几句，让他露出了微笑。他将双手插进了夹克的口袋里。

paragraphs.en: Ozma boldly answered, "No!" Then she ordered her army: "Forward, my brave soldiers, and fight for your Ruler and yourselves, unto death!"
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛大胆地回答：“不！”然后她命令她的军队：“勇敢的士兵们，向前冲！为我们的统治者和自己战斗到最后一刻！”

paragraphs.en: A general suggested, "We suffer from heart disease; slight excitement might kill us. Would it be wise to avoid this danger?"
paragraphs.zh: 一位将军建议说：“我们深受心脏病之苦；轻微的激动可能会要了我们的命。为了避免这种危险，是不是明智之举？”

paragraphs.en: "Soldiers should not have heart disease," said Ozma.
paragraphs.zh: “士兵不应患有心脏病。”奥兹玛说道。

paragraphs.en: Another general, twirling his moustache, declared, "Private soldiers are not afflicted that way. We will order our private to attack."
paragraphs.zh: 另一个将军一边转动着胡须，说道：“普通士兵不会这样。我们命令我们的士官去攻击。”

paragraphs.en: "Do so," replied Ozma.
paragraphs.zh: “就这样做吧。”奥兹玛说道。

paragraphs.en: The generals shouted, "Forward—march!" The colonels and majors followed with their commands.
paragraphs.zh: 将军们喊道：“前进——走！”各营长和团长紧随其后，发出命令。

paragraphs.en: The private charged at the enemy, knocking down ten men in the first row like toy soldiers. However, his spear could not penetrate their steel armor.
paragraphs.zh: 私兵冲向敌人，第一排的十名士兵在他面前如同玩具士兵般应声倒下。然而，他的长矛却无法穿透对方坚实的钢甲。

paragraphs.en: The captain of the Nomes was surprised by this sudden attack. He forgot to command his warriors, causing them to fall over. By then, another row had been knocked down.
paragraphs.zh: Nome军团的队长对这次突然袭击感到意外，竟忘了指挥他的战士们，结果他们一个个摔倒了。紧接着，又一排士兵被击倒了。

paragraphs.en: The captain swung his battle-axe, shattering the private's spear and leaving him helpless. The Nome King, seeing the chaos, hurled an egg from his right pocket at Ozma.
paragraphs.zh: 船长挥舞着战斧，劈断了士兵的长矛，留下他束手无策。 Nome王见状，从右口袋里扔出一个鸡蛋向奥兹玛砸去。

paragraphs.en: It struck his left eye, smashing and scattering, covering his face and hair with its contents.
paragraphs.zh: 它击中了他的左眼，粉碎散开，将碎片和内容物溅满了他的脸和头发。

paragraphs.en: The King screamed for help as the Scarecrow threw an egg at him, blinding his left eye. The Nomes' captain shouted in horror, and the warriors fled in panic, tumbling down the stairs or falling off the balcony into the cavern below.
paragraphs.zh: 国王惨叫求救，稻草人扔了个鸡蛋击中他，让他左眼失明。 Nome 部队的队长惊恐地大喊，战士们慌忙逃窜，有的从楼梯上滚了下来，有的则从阳台上摔进了下面的洞穴。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Billina flew to Dorothy and perched on the Lion's back. She whispered urgently, "Get the Nome King's jeweled belt! It unbuckles at the back.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，比林娜飞到多萝西身边，落在狮子背上，低声急切地说：“快去拿诺曼王的宝石腰带！它后面可以解开。”

paragraphs.en: Hurry, Dorothy!"
paragraphs.zh: “快点，多萝西！”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow threw a second egg, smashing it against the King’s right eye and blinding him completely. The King stood still in fear, unable to see which way to run.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人又扔出一枚鸡蛋，砸中国王的右眼，彻底让他失明。国王吓得呆立在原地，不知该往哪个方向逃跑。
